name: Simple Linear Regression
when_to_use: Continuous metric dependent variable, one metric predictor, linear relationship, normal and homoscedastic residuals.

expected_input.question: What is the linear relationship between the dependent variable and the predictors?

plain_explanation.purpose: Measures how much one thing changes when another changes, and draws the best line linking the two.
plain_explanation.when_to_use_plain: When you want to predict a number from a single factor.
plain_explanation.data_needed: Two numeric columns: what you want to predict and the factor that explains it.
plain_explanation.example: Estimate monthly sales from ad investment.
plain_explanation.diagram:
sales ^   . .  /
      |  . /.
      +------> ads  (line that best fits the points)
